title: A köztársasági elnök és hatáskörei (The President of the Republic & State Powers)
grammar: Institutional Governance, Separation of Powers & Public Law in Hungarian

sections.title: Lesson Goals
items: I can say who the head of state is, how the President is chosen and for how many years.
I can name three powers of the President: commander-in-chief, pardon, and sending a law to the Constitutional Court.
I can say where the President's official residence is.
I can read a short text about the President of the Republic.
